title: Turok Inspired Game
author: Independent-Arm-7397
selftext:
My 30-hour project.

The workflow and game mechanism are quite simple, I started with a detailed prompt and see the game, and then updated it as I want. The hardest part is building the map, assets. Creating dinosaurs also takes time too. 

Can you guys guess how much it costs. I'm using fable 5 model on Rezona Lab to build this game. Let me know if you want to see the prompt.
